# Optees

Optees is an open-source desktop operations-research toolkit. It provides local
workflows for Linear Programming, Mixed-Integer Linear Programming, five
Knapsack variants, continuous Nonlinear Programming, and Dijkstra shortest
paths on non-negative weighted graphs.

## Released Capabilities

- LP with HiGHS, JSON import/export, multiple-optima range analysis, and
  feasible-region views for low-dimensional problems.
- MILP with continuous, integer, and binary variables, time limits, and MIP
  gap controls.
- Knapsack 0/1, Bounded, Unbounded, Fractional, and Multi-dimensional.
- Continuous NLP using BFGS, Nelder-Mead, or L-BFGS-B. Results are local
  numerical candidates, not global-optimality certificates.
- Dijkstra shortest paths for directed or undirected graphs with finite,
  non-negative weights.
- A fully local, deterministic rule-based modeling assistant for LP, MILP,
  and Knapsack recommendations and validated JSON drafts.
